projecthero.undead.ability.vortex_bullet: Z: hold your arm out and wrench it round ten times against itself, then let it go: it untwists off your shoulder as a spinning drill that bores through every creature on a 30-block line, 18 damage each and flung out of the way, and bursts where it stops (the end of its range or the wall it buries itself in), blowing everything within 4 blocks away for 6 more. No blocks are broken. Your left and right arms take turns; the arm regrows. 8s cooldown.
projecthero.undead.ability.unluck_meteor: Shift + hold Z for 5 seconds: you turn Unluck on the sky. Red energy winds up round you, the sky darkens and a red ring grows on the ground where you are looking (up to 60 blocks); you are slowed while you call it. At 5 seconds a meteor streaks down on that spot: 40 damage at the centre, less out to 10 blocks, a huge throw and everything set on fire. The ground shakes, but no block is harmed. Let go before 5 seconds and nothing happens (no cooldown). 90s cooldown.
projecthero.undead.ability.reform.desc: Tap V: force your body back together at once. Every part that is gone or still regrowing is whole on the spot, you heal 3 hearts, and fire, poison, wither and every other harmful effect on you go. Works with auto-regrowth off too. Not while the katana is out (V puts it away). 20s cooldown.
projecthero.undead.ability.rib_cage_guar: Shift+V: you tear your ribcage open and the ribs spread out in front of you as a cage of bone, for as long as you hold Shift+V (4s at most; a quick tap keeps it up the whole 4s). From the front it stops arrows and other projectiles dead and takes 75% off melee hits, and whoever hits it takes 4 damage back. 12s cooldown once it folds away.
projecthero.undead.ability.bone_sword.de: Hold V for 2 seconds: you reach over, grab your off arm and wrench at it until it tears off, then crush it in your grip until it bursts, leaving Kurikara in your hand: a long, slightly curved bone katana with a blood-red edge line, a bone guard and a wrapped grip. 9 damage a hit, a sweep, a little more reach, and its sword skills on R, G, Z and C (X stays your own). The arm grows back once you put it away (V or Shift+V, or after 60s). Let go of V early and you let go of the arm. Needs both arms. 3s cooldown after.
projecthero.undead.ability.bone_sword_aw: V or Shift+V: the katana bursts into blood and bone and the arm grows back. 3s before you can draw it again.
projecthero.undead.ability.katana_cresce: Katana, R (Kurenai Mikazuki): a quick draw-cut that throws a red crescent of blood 16 blocks forward along your aim, 13 damage to everything it passes. 1.5s cooldown.
projecthero.undead.ability.katana_great_: Katana, G: raise Kurikara high overhead while the blood gathers on it, then bring it down: a towering crescent of blood 8 blocks wide runs 26 blocks along the ground, 24 damage and a heavy throw to everything in its way. 15s cooldown.
projecthero.undead.ability.crimson_flash: Katana, Z: an iaido draw. You blur 8 blocks forward along the ground (stopping short of a wall), the blade out and back in your grip before anyone sees it; a moment later everything you passed through is cut open for 16 damage, and you drink the blood you drew, healing 1 heart for each. 6s cooldown.
projecthero.undead.ability.blood_whirl.d: Katana, C: two full turns with the blade coated in your blood, cutting everything within 4.5 blocks all round you twice, 10 damage a cut, the second throwing them back. 8s cooldown.
projecthero.undead.ability.shoulder_swor: Shift + right click with any sword: drive it into your own shoulder, where it stays. While it is in, your bare-handed hits are the sword's hits: its damage and speed, its enchantments (sharpness, fire aspect...) and it wears like it would in your hand. Your regeneration is 10% slower and starts 10% later while it is in. Shift + right click with an empty hand pulls it back out. It drops with your things if you die (kept with keepInventory).
message.projecthero.undead.shoulder_full: There is already a sword in your shoulder
projecthero.guide.undead.bone_sword.body: Hold V: you reach across, grab your off arm at the shoulder and wrench at it, straining, while it slowly gives (the V box fills red). After 2 seconds it tears off; you grip it hard until it bursts in your hand in a spray of blood and bone, and what is left is Kurikara: the arm's bone drawn out into a long, slender, slightly curved katana, a wavy line of blood along its white edge, an oval bone guard and a grip wrapped in dark red; blood drips off it. Left click hits for 9 and sweeps like a sword, with a little more reach. While it is out R, G, Z and C are its sword skills (see Kurikara's sword skills) and the arm does not grow back. V or Shift+V, or after 60 seconds, and it bursts into blood and bone and the arm regrows. You need both arms to draw it. A plain tap of V is Reform instead (see Regeneration).
projecthero.guide.undead.sword_controls: Kurikara's sword skills (while it is out)
Shift + right click with any sword and you drive it into your own shoulder; it stays there, sticking out of you. With nothing in your hand you then hit with it: its damage and speed, its enchantments, and its wear. A blade in you slows your regeneration: 10% slower, and 10% longer before a lost part starts. Shift + right click with an empty hand pulls it out again. If you die it drops with your things (unless keepInventory is on).
projecthero.guide.undead.meteor.body: Your ultimate (Shift + hold Z). As Fuuko's Unluck turned on the sky in chapter one, you call a meteor down on what you are looking at: hold for 5 seconds while the sky darkens red and a ring marks the spot, and it falls in a streak of fire. 40 damage at the centre, a 10-block blast, fire and a shockwave; nothing is broken. Let go early and it is called off for free. 90 seconds before you can call another.
